headline: Oil Rises $2 on Middle East Supply Concerns After Houthi Attacks
summary: Crude oil rose $2 as Houthi attacks in Saudi Arabia escalated Middle East geopolitical tensions and heightened concerns regarding potential crude supply disruptions.
why: Crude oil prices are a major determinant of global inflation expectations, transportation costs, and central bank policy.

impacts.name: Brent Crude
impacts.why: Military strikes in Saudi Arabia raised the perceived risk premium on Middle East crude exports.

impacts.name: Energy
impacts.why: Higher oil prices bolster expected operating revenues and margins for energy producers.

why_moved: Crude jumped by $2 a barrel due to supply risk premiums following Houthi attacks targeting Saudi Arabia.
